responsibility: This header supplies default definitions for a large set of target macros and backend policy constants when a port does not override them. It covers assembler syntax/output helpers, TLS/common label conventions, code-generation heuristics such as branch and move ratios, stack probing and stack-check defaults, vtable descriptor defaults, DWARF defaults, and target-unit typedefs. Its role is to provide the baseline target configuration layer for tm.h-based backend customization.
